text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin assessing this newborn's respiratory distress, could you tell me the infant's gestational age at birth and the time of onset of these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text: Was the infant intubated immediately after birth, and did they receive exogenous surfactant therapy? I also need to know if the mother had any signs of infection like chorioamnionitis during labor.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Tachypnea, Subcostal and intercostal retractions, Nasal flaring, Cyanosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the maternal diabetes and cesarean delivery, I suspect transient tachypnea or RDS, so I need to visualize the lung fields. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
